d:
This is a sorta-visual novel featuring Zetsu Red's main OC, Suzuka Minase. It's completely fanmade and unofficial.

I picked all the content I could find (mangas, short stories, single pictures, variant sets...) featuring Suzuka, and tried to order it so it could fit during a school calendar year, as if she was playing through the worst Persona game in existence. I suck at image editing, so I kept it to a minimum (and even then it's not great, but hey).

Please note that the artist himself has said that he did not follow a specific timeline when publishing his pictures & stories, except for the mangas which follow one another. So if you disagree with the order I put the pictures in, feel free to make your own headcanon (like I did, basically).

I tried to follow a "logical" order, where things would escalate over time. I tried to make everything fit actual Japanese holidays, but it's highly possible there are some discrepancies (for example, pics #135-139 feature an inconsistent day, but if you take a calendar, you realize this scene happens before the first manga which is where Suzuka's story begins).

This features content from...
- the first manga translated by MCDecaux: https://e-hentai.org/g/2783081/49ccc537b7/
- the second manga translated by alicehiro: https://e-hentai.org/g/3257072/665e4c6fa3/
- the translated pics set by MCDecaux: https://e-hentai.org/g/3777414/2a8efdd6d7/
- the artist's pixiv & fanbox: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/2587756
- an art of Suzuka by artist Rabbi: https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/122164748 - it's the last picture.

As far as I know, the only pictures I did not include were the two most recent Christmas ones (the dinner + the short story), because there is only one Christmas Day in a calendar year, and the "Year of the Dragon" one (because I included the Year of the Rabbit in the story - and you only have one Chinese New Year every year, duh).

You can find them in MCDecaux's Suzuka gallery linked above.

I might edit or expand it over time if I feel like it. The artist has already announced he would publish something in August, which should expand on his two short stories (Drive + Walk).
n: [Image Set] [Zetsu Red Zone(Zetsu Red)] Suzuka Minase - Fan VN
